description: Inspect the append-only event audit ledger, query structured changesets, and generate session post-mortems. Supported actions: log (query event ledger with filters), changelog (get structured graph diff since timestamp or session), post_mortem (analyze a session and produce a structured markdown report).

action.description: The event query action to execute.

session_id.description: Session ID for log or post_mortem.

since.description: ISO timestamp or relative duration (e.g. 2h, 1d) for log or changelog.

since_session.description: Session ID to diff from for changelog.

name: get_events
